name: artlist
title: artlist · royalty-free music, SFX & footage search
description: Interface to Artlist.io: search 25k+ royalty-free songs, SFX, stock footage and video templates through Artlist's public search GraphQL API, with a console to search and listen in the browser. Keyless for search/preview/metadata; streams AAC previews from Artlist's CDN (relayed through the module, the CDN wants an artlist.io Referer). Licensed downloads require your own Artlist account token (kept off-chain). Stdlib-only. Also an MCP server (HTTP /mcp and stdio).
state: ~/.mod/artlist/cache.db (GraphQL responses by query hash) · ~/.mod/artlist/previews/ · ~/.mod/artlist/token (optional, your Artlist bearer)

app.docs: /artlist/ -> the console (search + player); app.css, app.js, fonts/ beside it

stream.docs: ?u=<https://*.artlist.io preview url> -> relays the AAC with the Referer the CDN requires; Range passes through

voices.docs: ?page=&k= -> AI voiceover voices; accents carry preview_url

preview.docs: ?id= -> downloads the AAC preview to ~/.mod/artlist/previews/, returns the path

gq.docs: {query, variables} -> raw GraphQL passthrough to search-api.artlist.io

mcp.docs: MCP JSON-RPC: artlist_music, artlist_sfx, artlist_footage, artlist_templates, artlist_voices, artlist_song, artlist_gq, artlist_status

frontend: app/ (index.html + app.css + app.js, plain ES module, served by artlistapi/server.py on the same port at /artlist/)
